principalFront.selectionEvidence: Survey edges 2–5 form the southwest-facing street frontage. Edge 4 is a 0.148 m snap connector, preserved in the footprint. Registered current photo number 429, the right entrance adjoining the church fence, and the narrow front width agree. A single minimum-score edge is only a roof-intersection fragment.

heights.bodyEavesAdmission: The two outer front roof/wall corners give 14.3725 and 14.5995 m NAP. Subtract the 0.974 m ground datum for a 13.3985–13.6255 m body/eaves range. The 13.5120 m nominal averages those ends for a bounded facade drawing; keep the surveyed sloping roof separate.
heights.exclusionReason: Walls 9 and 11 run along the sides. A two-near-vertices heuristic falsely admitted them through one endpoint. All vertices of true front walls 12/13/16/17 lie within 0.15 m of the selected frontage line; 16 is the tiny snap connector.
heights.roofLimits: Front body/eaves and main roof crest are separate. The rear roofs at 10.08–14.85 m NAP must not truncate the front body. Roof parts own their tops; avoid wall caps or unsupported returns. AHN-derived planes and the 0.266 m reconstruction RMSE do not measure facade stone ornament.

normalization.precision: Approximate visual ratios from unrectified current views, typically ±0.04–0.06 facade fraction. Lower/crown/depth uncertainty can be larger. These are not photogrammetric measurements.
